scope: Actual rendered Smart Practice/knowledge components with real Node bridges; surrounding navigation/audio stubbed. Not full-app, service-worker, hardware or live-provider E2E.
checks: Another choice changes the eligible skill and persists on rerender.
Pause renders bilingual Resume and saved-state controls.
Finish is distinct from success and does not complete unfinished steps.
History answer saves 1/2 progress; pausing preserves it and unlocks free topics.
History resumes after bridge reload, completes exactly two local answers, then suggests without auto-launch.
Rendered 768px tablet component has no horizontal document overflow.
A start response released after child switching neither launches nor overwrites the new child view.
No page-level JavaScript exceptions during these component interactions.
